strings.string: Where to send commands, and what the glance shows.
https://your-home-assistant, no trailing slash. Must be HTTPS with a certificate that validates.
A long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile, under Security.
Entity whose state the glance shows, e.g. cover.garage_door. Leave blank for none.
The Home Assistant event each button fires, e.g. garmin_edge. Your automations trigger on it.
The button label, which is also sent as the action name your automation matches on. Entity is optional and only drives the state display. Leave the label blank to hide this button.
Shown on the button, e.g. Open garage
